Your next steps

Here's everything that happens next.

  1. 01

    Payment Done

    Whop processed your order and emailed the receipt. Billing and cancellation are managed in your Whop account.

  2. 02

    Activate your indicators

    Sign in with the Whop account you just used, then confirm the email on your NinjaTrader account with a 6-digit code. It can be different from your Whop email. No NinjaTrader account yet? You can create a free one during setup.

    Start activation →
  3. 03

    Join the Discord and open the masterclass

    Your Discord and masterclass access come through Whop. Open StartUpTrading in your Whop account, connect Discord to get into the members' channels, and start the masterclass from there.

  4. 04

    Add the indicators to a chart

    As soon as activation finishes, we email install instructions to your NinjaTrader address. Open NinjaTrader, follow the guide, and add them to a chart.

Need a hand?

Email support@startuptrading.com and include the email you used at checkout. If an indicator doesn't show up, contact us before buying anything else.
